Part1.title: 朗读万能框架
Part1.content:
【准备45秒】
1. 快速默读，标注重音词（名词、动词、数字、专有名词）。
2. 标出断句点（逗号、句号、分号）。
3. 在脑中模拟一遍语调变化。

【作答45秒】
• 匀速朗读，每句话结束后略作停顿（0.3 秒）。
• 陈述句末↓降调，疑问句末↑升调。
• 数字与专有名词放慢，字字清晰。

⭐ 示例开场：
"Good morning, everyone. Today I'd like to announce that…"

Part2.title: 图片描述结构模板（45s准备 / 30s作答）
Part2.content:
Opening  : This picture shows [location / setting].
People   : There are [number] people who appear to be [action].
Foreground: In the foreground, I can see [object / detail].
Background: In the background, there is/are [element].
Mood     : The overall atmosphere seems [adjective].
Closing  : This looks like [interpretation / guess].

⭐ 常用词组：
in the foreground / background / center of the image
appear to be + V-ing  |  is/are wearing  |  is/are holding
on the left/right  |  next to  |  in front of

Part3.title: 即兴问答答题公式（Q5/Q6: 15s | Q7: 30s）
Part3.content:
Q5 / Q6（15秒）：直接答 → 简短理由
  "I [answer]. For example / because [brief reason]."

Q7（30秒）：立场 → 原因1 → 原因2 → 总结
  "I would [action] because, first, [reason 1].
   Furthermore, [reason 2].
   Therefore, I think [restate position]."

⭐ 过渡词：
First, … / In addition, … / For example, … / As a result, …
However, … / On the other hand, … / Therefore, …

Part4.title: 信息题答题技巧（45s读信息 | Q8/Q9: 15s | Q10: 30s）
Part4.content:
【准备45秒】快速定位：日期、时间、地点、人物、数字等关键信息。

Q8 / Q9（15秒）——直接引用信息，无需个人观点：
  "According to the information, [fact from schedule/text]."

Q10（30秒）——可结合推理：
  "Based on the information, I would recommend [option]
   because [reason from text]. Additionally, [detail]."

⭐ 注意：Q10 会播放两遍，请利用第二遍确认关键词。

Part5.title: 观点表达黄金结构（45s准备 / 60s作答）
Part5.content:
【准备45秒】脑中草拟：立场 + 2个理由 + 结束语。

【60秒作答时间轴】
[0–10s]  立场："In my opinion, [position]."
[10–35s] 理由1："First, [reason]. For instance, [example]."
[35–55s] 理由2："Furthermore, [reason]. This means [impact]."
[55–60s] 总结："Therefore, I strongly believe [restate]."

⭐ 加分词组：
significantly / particularly / consequently / as a result
It is widely acknowledged that… / Research suggests that…
